description.value: Hatzic Prairie Market is a small convenience store serving the rural Hatzic Prairie area near Mission, BC. Sitting in an agricultural flatland community with limited services, it likely serves as one of the few nearby stops for supplies. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley backroads may find it a useful resupply point.

address.value: 10814 Farms Rd, Mission, BC V2V 7G9, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a convenience store (shop=convenience) named Hatzic Prairie Market with a Facebook page as the only URL. The Facebook prefetch returned only a 'temporarily blocked' wall with no business content, making the website effectively unusable as an evidence source. All amenity and contact fields must therefore rely solely on the sparse OSM tags (building=yes, name, shop=convenience), which provide no amenity-level detail.
concerns: Facebook website fetch was blocked ('temporarily blocked') — no business content was retrievable; all amenities are unverified.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the business name and Facebook URL reference Mission, BC; Hatzic Prairie is within the District of Mission, not Chilliwack.
No address or phone number present in OSM tags or retrievable from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real convenience store in a rural area with no evidence of closure; useful resupply stop for cyclists on Fraser Valley back roads.
